description: Synthetic, simplified staged-tool replays for address resolution, not exact MCP response schemas. No live map calls or credentials.
replay_context: Each case is independent. All trip requirements unrelated to place identity are already resolved. Ask for the next action and point record, not a complete route. Hide expected_next and must_not from the test agent.

cases.request: 从上海人民广场出发跑约8公里再回来，北京时间2026年10月10日21点，六分配速，中途休息10分钟，最多9公里。
cases.expected_next: Search landmark POIs in the requested city and obtain the chosen POI detail before routing. Do not accept the road-level hit as the square.
must_not: Call directions using the road-level hit
Use numeric coordinate validity as proof of the requested landmark

cases.request: 从杭州市中心广场出发骑一圈，其他要求不变，别再多问，先算起来。
cases.expected_next: Ask the user to choose between the two distinct plausible squares, showing addresses; do not pick the first result or start directions.
must_not: Treat the desire for speed as resolving the place identity

cases.request: 从武汉市星湖公园出发跑一圈，没有指定哪个入口。
cases.expected_next: Use the unique semantically matching park POI, disclose its exact address and map-point basis, and preserve the fact that no entrance has been confirmed. Do not ask the user to choose a park versus irrelevant stations.
must_not: Ask merely because the raw search returned more than one item
Label the map point as user-confirmed

cases.request: 跑步环线的起点用我刚才选的合成星湖公园东门，POI fixture-east。不要换成公园中心。
cases.expected_next: Keep the selected entrance ID and detail coordinates; do not search and replace it with the park center, and do not ask the user to choose it again.
must_not: Replace the entrance with a similarly named center point
Repeat an already answered selection question

cases.request: 就从刚才搜索出的公园出发，地图详情失败也没关系，先给我算距离。

result.retry_instruction: Do not retry in this session

cases.expected_next: Keep the point unresolved, report the failed detail query and pause without routing or retrying, following the supplied service instruction.
must_not: Borrow a road geocode or guessed coordinate
Treat a result with no location as a resolved point

cases.request: 刚才跑步环线的A是同名道路，起点改成真正广场。其余要求不变。
cases.expected_next: Replace A's identity and coordinates, discard and requery A-B and C-A, retain unchanged B-C only with its original evidence, then recalculate all arrival times, opening-window decisions and maps before delivery.
must_not: Reuse A-B or C-A distances with a new label
Keep old arrival times or old route-map links
Assume local ID A makes changed coordinates equivalent
